label: INA219 current sensor
about: Measures the current and the voltage that a circuit draws.
description: The chip measures the voltage across a small shunt resistor and the voltage of the supply, and it sends both over I2C. A microcontroller reads the current and the power from them. It handles up to 26 V on the bus and 3.2 A with the 0.1 ohm resistor of the board.
